native_result.query: How does incarceration affect the wealth of black individuals based on their income levels?
native_result.HypoA: The negative impact of incarceration on wealth for black individuals may be less for the high-income group than those at lower wealth ranges.
native_result.HypoB: In the NLSY79-based sample, incarceration is associated with lower and flatter wealth trajectories for black Americans, and the association varies systematically by income level — measured by a proxy (terciles of 1985 composite wealth within the black subsample, since the dataset has no income variable). Ever-jailed black individuals (1985-1994) in the middle and especially the highest baseline-wealth terciles diverge sharply from never-jailed peers: median wealth change over 1985-1996 is roughly zero/negative for the ever-jailed (middle: -$1,000, wealth falls to $0 by 1990 and stays; high: -$5,800, wealth falls within 1985-1990 and only partially recovers by 1996) while never-jailed peers accumulate (+$6,231 and +$8,825). Median differences in wealth change: about -$7,000 (middle tercile) and -$14,750 (high tercile), so the absolute gap associated with incarceration widens with baseline economic standing. In the lowest tercile the association is masked by a $0 wealth floor (both groups at $0 median each year), although ever-jailed still show lower mean wealth by 1996 (~$6.1k vs ~$23.3k). These are associational, observational patterns (no causal counterfactual; selection on unobserved traits cannot be ruled out); the 1985-1990 divergence timing is descriptive.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) load data/nls_incarceration_processed.csv; 2) filter black subsample (n=3,013); 3) build income-level proxy: terciles of composite_wealth_1985 within black (low 1,316 / mid 693 / high 1,004); 4) cross stratum x ever_jailed x year: yearly medians with 20k bootstrap CIs and means; 5) individual wealth changes 85->96 with bootstrap CIs and jailed-minus-not median difference with bootstrap CI; 6) robustness: terciles of 1990 wealth and full-sample terciles; 7) Mann-Whitney U on 1996 wealth as context. Script: work/analysis_incarceration.py (executed; full output in work/analysis_output.txt).
